newsitem.title: UK: General Accident eases as UBS repeats sell.
newsitem.headline: General Accident eases as UBS repeats sell.

text.p: Shares in General Accident Plc fell on Thursday as brokerage UBS repeated its sell recommendation, dealers said.
The shares, down 12p to 945-1/2 at 1357 GMT, extended their slide after the company posted its results on Tuesday.
"The shares just look overvalued," one market maker said, noting that they had soared by almost 22 percent from April 21 to May 9, when they finished at a record high at 974p.
Earlier this week, brokerage SBC Warburg cut its rating on the stock to "hold" from "add." --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
